project_context.name: PropManage
project_context.description: Romanian property administration platform & renovation marketplace with escrow. 4 roles: Client, Specialist, Operator, Admin.
project_context.core_mandate: Unify design logic across all roles. Strict Hick's Law (2-5 actions/screen). Theme toggle (Light/Dark). Consistent Lime green accent.

theme_strategy.overview: Explicit Light and Dark themes switchable by the user via a top-right toggle. The Lime Green accent (#d4ff3a) MUST be consistent across both themes to avoid 'chaos'.

brand_accent.usage_rules: Use #d4ff3a as a fill color for Primary CTAs, badges, and progress bars IN BOTH THEMES. Text INSIDE the lime shape must always be black (#000000). NEVER use #d4ff3a for raw text on a white background (Light theme); instead, use the accessible olive variant (#4d6600) if colored text is absolutely necessary, though filled shapes are preferred.

font_pairings.body: Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif (Highly readable, clean data display)

spacing_and_layout.desktop_viewport: Optimized for 13-14 inch laptops (1280px - 1440px wide). Avoid excessive stretching. Max-w-7xl for main content areas.

hicks_law_role_blueprints.global_rule: Limit primary actions to 2-5 per screen. Use progressive disclosure (wizards, dialogs) rather than giant forms.

client.layout: Mobile-first bottom navigation (Acasă, Lucrări, Solicită [Central FAB], Proprietăți, Setări). On Desktop: Top navigation with 'Solicită' as primary CTA top-right.
client.journey: Focus on property health and requesting services. The 'Solicită' wizard is the primary interaction point.

specialist.layout: Desktop focus. Left sidebar or clean top nav. Dashboard must immediately show 'Astăzi ai:' (New requests, active jobs, notifications, wallet).
specialist.journey: Action-oriented: Accept leads, Send offers. Use clear data tables and Kanban boards for active works.

operator.layout: Desktop split-pane or list-detail view. Left side: Unassigned queue. Right side: Details and action buttons.
operator.journey: High throughput. 'Resolve in 2 clicks'. Buttons for Approve/Reject/Escalate must be immediately accessible and fixed at the bottom of the right pane.

admin.layout: Desktop complex sidebar (collapsible). 40 modules categorized into accordions (Control Tower, Finanțe, etc.).
admin.journey: Analytical and configuration-heavy. Use KpiCards, DataTable with sticky headers, and AIInsightCards at the top of relevant sections.

components.buttons: DSButton. Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary CTAs to make them unmissable. Rounded-md for secondary/tertiary actions. Primary CTA is ALWAYS Lime Green (#d4ff3a) with black text.
components.cards: Bordered (border border-border) with solid surface colors. Minimal shadows. Inside spacing exactly gap-3.
components.badges: DSBadge. 7 types. Soft background (10% opacity) with solid text. Success: green bg/text, AI: violet bg/text.
components.data_table: Sticky headers, sort/search/export always top-right of table. Zebra striping or clear border-b for rows.
components.theme_toggle: IconButton placed consistently in the top-right header across ALL public pages and logged-in dashboards.

accessibility_and_ux.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA. Use text-shadow if overlaying text on images.
accessibility_and_ux.readability: No text overlaps. Use tight padding. If container shrinks, text should truncate with ellipsis (...) or wrap gracefully.
accessibility_and_ux.empty_states: EmptyState component MUST have a clear illustration, a reassuring message, and ONE primary action button.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: IMPLEMENT EXPLICIT LIGHT AND DARK THEME CAPABILITY using Tailwind's 'dark:' classes. DO NOT force dark mode only.
Include a Theme Toggle button in the header for all roles.
USE THE LIME GREEN ACCENT (#d4ff3a) consistently for Primary CTAs in BOTH themes. Text inside Lime buttons MUST BE BLACK.
Apply Hick's Law: Never overwhelm the user. Max 5 primary actions per screen.
Ensure the Admin dashboard is coherent: use an accordion sidebar for the 40 modules to prevent cognitive overload.
Use existing Business Design System component nomenclature conceptually (KpiCard, AIInsightCard, DSButton).
All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.
NEVER use generic fonts like Inter for Headings; use Outfit. Body text uses Plus Jakarta Sans.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays where text readability is compromised.
